summary.title: Professional Summary
summary.p1: Full-Stack Developer with 3+ years of experience designing, developing, and maintaining enterprise web applications using C#, .NET/.NET Core, Angular, TypeScript, REST APIs, and SQL Server. Strong background in backend development, business logic, database-driven applications, and system integrations.
summary.p2: Experienced developing configurable software products for multiple customers, implementing customer-specific business rules and functionality while maintaining a shared application core. Hands-on experience with WMS, inventory and logistics systems, warehouse automation, production support, and integrations with external systems and devices.
summary.p3: Strong problem-solving and debugging skills, with experience working across backend, frontend, database, and integration layers. Comfortable collaborating with technical and non-technical stakeholders, analyzing requirements, and learning new technologies and architectures.
summary.interests: Backend development and architecture, distributed systems, cloud technologies, system integrations, performance optimization, and exploring new technologies and development practices.

string.h1: Developed and maintained enterprise Warehouse Management System (WMS) applications using C#, .NET/.NET Core, Angular, TypeScript, REST APIs, and SQL Server.
string.h2: Managed and maintained 9 WMS projects simultaneously across different Angular and .NET versions, ensuring application stability, compatibility, and reliable operation across customer environments.
string.h3: Led end-to-end development from requirements analysis and data modeling in Erwin Data Modeler through backend development, database implementation, frontend development, deployment, and user training.
string.h4: Developed a configurable WMS product for multiple customers, implementing customer-specific parameters, business rules, and functionality while maintaining a shared application core.
string.h5: Designed and implemented backend business logic and database operations supporting inventory, orders, picking, and warehouse processes.
string.h6: Developed and optimized SQL Server queries and T-SQL operations for business-critical warehouse workflows.
string.h7: Built Ionic mobile applications for Zebra handheld devices, integrating mobile workflows with the WMS platform and warehouse operations.
string.h8: Integrated Pick-to-Light (PTL) systems, ZPL label printing, and robotic sorter automation with software-driven warehouse workflows.
string.h9: Developed an internal BI framework that enabled administrative users to create custom dashboards and reports, reducing reliance on IT support.
string.h10: Provided advanced production support and real-time troubleshooting, diagnosing issues across application, database, integration, and infrastructure layers to minimize disruption to warehouse operations.
string.h11: Collaborated with developers, users, and business stakeholders to analyze requirements, investigate issues, and deliver improvements to production systems.
string.h12: Used Git and Azure DevOps throughout the development and delivery workflow.

concrete.h1: Designed, developed, and maintained a business application used across production plants and construction sites to monitor concrete performance from production through delivery.
concrete.h2: Developed configurable workflows and customer-specific functionality while maintaining a common application architecture.
concrete.h3: Implemented complex mathematical and chemical calculations for cement tests, specimens, and quality assurance processes.
concrete.h4: Developed backend business logic and database-driven functionality supporting laboratory, production, and quality-control workflows.
concrete.h5: Automated Excel and PDF report generation, reducing manual reporting time by approximately 40% while supporting personalized outputs for different users.
concrete.h6: Developed responsive and mobile-compatible functionality using Cordova, enabling access to application workflows across different devices.
concrete.h7: Worked directly with end-users to analyze requirements and improve scheduling, task-management, and operational workflows.
concrete.h8: Investigated and resolved application issues, ensuring reliable operation for users across different production environments.
